objects.text: We met on a rainy afternoon and talked until the café closed. Three years, two cities and one very nervous proposal later, we said yes in front of everyone we love.
Today I promised you forever. Every day after this one I will keep choosing you — on the easy days and the hard ones.
Surrounded by the people who made us who we are.
You are my today and all of my tomorrows
We danced until our feet hurt and laughed until our cheeks ached.
Promises made with shaking hands and steady hearts — to laugh, to listen and to choose each other every day.

objects.text: Two hundred kilometres of blue on one side and mountains on the other.
Two weeks, one backpack each and no plan after day three. We followed the coast, ate everything and said yes to every detour.
The best places we found were never on the map — only down the next small street.
Remember the warm bread, the wrong turns and how the sea looked at six in the evening. Let's go back.
Some days are worth remembering forever.

objects.text: You arrived at 6:42 in the morning, weighing 3.2 kg, with a full head of hair and the loudest little voice. Everything changed — in the best way.
One day you will read this and wonder how small you were. We will always remember how you changed our world.
One year of you — our favourite year.
